#   chapter_xref           3066   backticked chapter pointer `NN` / `NN:LINE` / references/NN-*.md — a cross-reference, not a quantity

#   list_index              217   the ordinal of an ordered-list item, at the list-marker position only — other numbers on the line are still rows
#   heading_number           60   section number in a markdown heading (## 8. ...)

#   url_doi_hash             45   digits inside a URL, DOI, domain path or a git commit hash
#   anchor_link              29   digits inside a markdown (#anchor-1984) target
#   math_display_block       19   literal inside a $$...$$ display-math expression
#   math_inline              18   literal inside a $...$ inline-math expression
# CLASS distribution: derived=3045, unclassified=1794, external=283, illustrative=30
# CLASS rules, in cascade order (first match wins):
#   derived      value literal (distinctive) present in a reference-impl module or test; OR the line
#                names a backticked identifier that exists in module source; OR the token sits inside
#                an inline `code span` (a formula fragment the impl mirrors); OR the line is a
#   external     the line carries a citation marker (Author YEAR, et al., `99`, measured/empirical/USGS/SRTM).
#   illustrative the line carries a worked-example marker (e.g., for example, sims_illustrative, panel, demo).
#   unclassified no rule fired. THIS BUCKET IS REAL AND LARGE (1794). It is not 'clean'; it is 'undecided'.
# VERDICT rules (provisional — later waves may REASSIGN a verdict, never add or drop a row):
#   distinctive = token has a decimal point/exponent, or |int| > 10. Non-distinctive tokens (0..10)
#   match code literals by coincidence, so a literal match on them is NOT evidence.
#   guarded         distinctive AND the value appears as a literal in reference-impl/tests/test_*.py;
#                   source_or_guard names up to two test_file::function rows.
#   unguarded       distinctive AND in a module but no test; OR non-distinctive (marked
#   unreproducible  the value appears in no module and no test. For class=external with a citation
#                   this is expected and benign; for class=derived it is the alarming case.
# FREEZE RULE: this row list is final. A numeric claim discovered later that is not here goes to
# OPEN-ITEMS.md as a census-miss; it must NOT be appended to this file.
